# Explore Canadian forest growth and yield models

This private-first pilot catalogue has one entry per model, with
geographic coverage claims, source information, and links. Browse the
[model catalogue](models.qmd) to filter by model type, species keyword,
stand origin, and province or territory.

**Pilot data are not authoritative.** Records and links marked unverified
have not been checked against their cited sources. A province-level filter
can include a claim limited to a named subregion; read each coverage
qualifier before using a model for a location. Missing information is
shown as "Not recorded", not inferred from other fields or links.

The map and downloadable query database are not yet available. No
geographic polygon should be interpreted as calibration or validation
evidence until it is explicitly supported by a coverage claim.
